slimeGel.name: Slime Gel
slimeGel.description: A small glossy blob of bright lime-green translucent slime gel, slightly irregular in shape, with a few tiny bubbles inside and bright white highlights.

starterTunic.name: Starter Tunic
starterTunic.description: A simple beginner tunic equipped in the Chest slot. It affects equipment progression without changing the selected premade character artwork.

starterTrousers.name: Starter Trousers
starterTrousers.description: Simple beginner trousers equipped in the Legs slot. They remain gameplay equipment without requiring separate character-layer art.

wornLeatherBoots.name: Worn Leather Boots
wornLeatherBoots.description: Basic beginner boots equipped in the Feet slot. They remain gameplay equipment without requiring separate character-layer art.
